rows.findingsAndResolution: Genuine grammatical/scientific clarification: the ascorbic acid, not the performed test, is an antioxidant; its reducing action produces the observation. One lab evidence chain, with provided valid protocol/control/material. A generic reducing response alone is not a uniquely selective vitamin-C proof for arbitrary mixtures.

rows.findingsAndResolution: One checkable material-based antioxidant transfer/evaluation candidate. Explicitly distinguishes reduction/oxidation protection from antimicrobial action; no sterility or safe shelf-life claim. It is an authored transfer of actual HE Q1.5 antioxidant/preservation context, not a separately worded official redox-preservation requirement. HOLD source/applicability acceptance; generated candidate alone cannot settle it.
